translations.web: I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.
translations.bsb: I brought you into a fertile land to eat its fruit and bounty, but you came and defiled My land and made My inheritance detestable.
